about_the_game:
Welcome to the RAINBOX, A colorfully monochrome world for you to solve puzzles in!

You play as the adorable white cube named Reynold, and you must solve puzzles to progress. You have the ability to push blocks, and you must use that to get all of the blocks on their goals. Seems simple, right? 

Well, it is, at first.

It's not as simple as just pushing the blocks on the goal. Each individual block has a completely different mechanic. Sometimes you have to PULL the block onto the goal, other times you have to SCARE it onto the goal, and other times still the block will just kill you.

The game stacks on different colored friends with different colored personalities, all interacting to make the puzzles more difficult and complex. With 9 different blocks, it gets pretty complicated.

Features

  • 10 Individual Stages

  • 54 Engaging Puzzles

  • 9 Different Blocks with Unique Mechanics

short_description: A cute and simple Sokoban-like puzzle adventure through the rainbow! Push blocks to solve puzzles in a variety of rainbow-themed levels. Each block has a different mechanic for you to work around, can you get all of them to their goal while dealing with their personalities?
